note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

precepts.why:
“His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.” Scripture owns the Most High as the king of terrors, and Beth-shemesh shows why.

It was not just the other nations that had to keep discretion with the ark of the covenant. It was forbidden to touch it or look into it unless the Lord gave you authority, no matter what tribe you were, even Levi. The men of Beth-shemesh got too excited and got nosy, taking a peek to see what the writing of God looked like, and “he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men.” He was killing thousands at a time, and his judgments are terrifying.

That is why the people cried, “Who is able to stand before this holy Lord God?” and sent to Kirjath-jearim for someone to come fetch the ark. And it is a lesson for us: we have to have a level of discipline over our eyes. With these devices today it is very easy to take a two second look at what you know you should not be looking at. Guard your eyes.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

precepts.why:
“Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.” The children of men here is everybody: heathen and wicked Israelite alike.

The Philistines were smitten for taking the ark, and now the men of Beth-shemesh, Israelites, were smitten for looking into it: “the Lord had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter.” He is terrible in his doing, and being an Israelite did not spare the ones who went where the Lord gave them no authority to go.

So the people lamented and said, “Who is able to stand before this holy Lord God?” That is the right question. Come and see his works, and learn to fear him.

points: The ark of the Lord was in the country of the Philistines seven months, and the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, asking how to send it back to his place. Seven months of that plague and they had to get it out of the land.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: The priests answered, send it not empty, but in any wise return him a trespass offering; then ye shall be healed. A trespass offering acknowledges you did wrong. The offering was five golden emerods and five golden mice, according to the number of the lords of the Philistines, images of the very things that marred the land, and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel; peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: Their own priests warned them from Israel's history: wherefore then do ye harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? They did not want to end up like Egypt, so they said, let us learn the lesson and get this ark back.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: The test: make a new cart, take two milch kine on which there hath come no yoke, shut up their calves at home, lay the ark on the cart with the jewels of gold in a coffer, and send it away. If it goeth up by the way of his own coast to Beth-shemesh, then he hath done us this great evil: but if not, we shall know it was a chance that happened to us, maybe just a disease spreading through the nation.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: The kine took the straight way to the way of Beth-shemesh, lowing as they went, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left, with the lords of the Philistines following to the border. Cows with no yoke, separated from their calves, walking a straight line home to Israel: that settled that it was the hand of the Lord.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: They of Beth-shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley, and when they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, they rejoiced to see it. As soon as the ark crossed that border coming home, it was rejoicing time in Israel.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: The cart came into the field of Joshua, a Beth-shemite, and stood by a great stone; they clave the wood of the cart and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the Lord, and the Levites took down the ark and the coffer with the jewels of gold.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: The golden emerods were one for each lord's city, Ashdod, Gaza, Askelon, Gath, and Ekron, and when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day. The Philistines understood it really was the Lord that had afflicted them.

note.label: 1 Samuel 6: The Ark Returned with a Trespass Offering

points: He smote the men of Beth-shemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the Lord, even fifty thousand and threescore and ten men. It was not just the other nations that had to keep discretion with the ark of the covenant; it was forbidden to touch it or look into it unless the Lord gave you authority, no matter what tribe you were, even Levi.

They got too excited and got nosy, taking a peek to see what the writing of God looked like, and the Lord smote fifty thousand and seventy of them just for peeking. That shows us we have to have a level of discipline over our eyes; with these devices today it is very easy to take a two second look at what you know you should not be looking at. Guard your eyes.
